evidence.specification: Reviewed docs/spec/NATIVE-V1-CANDIDATE.md and docs/spec/candidate.json: 13 proposed semantic invariants, 44 exact implementation source files, 153 executed historical test identities, and a compatibility/authority matrix across core, evidence, planning, profiles, imports, file storage, read/composition APIs, kernel/IDL and distribution. The readonly CI checker validates the indexed source/proof digests and actual test declarations. Disposable changed-source and invented-witness cases were rejected; the original repository index passed before and afterward.
evidence.review: Current guides distinguish completed implementation from the original extraction/checkpoint findings. Local document/source/evidence links passed. No runtime code or alpha contract semantics changed, no historical proof was rewritten, and no consumer was migrated. Candidate revision 2026-09-07.1 is explicitly a proposal: concrete v1 envelope mapping, backward support, published conformance identities and an explicit freeze decision remain separate admitted future work, not an inferred native-v1 release.
